title: Evaluation Design Flaw Finder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Read a described comparison of a local and a cloud model, then judge eight statements about it as a flaw or not a flaw.

learningObjectives: The learner will critique a described evaluation by judging each of 8 statements about it as a flaw or not a flaw, with at least 7 of 8 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Rewrite the described evaluation in three sentences so that none of the five flaws remains.
commonMisconceptions: A comparison of two systems needs no controls if one is clearly stronger.
A single run is enough to rank.
A result scored by the system that produced it is neutral.
Having a method is the same as having a fair method.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.
